title: CVM Fines Daniel Vorcaro R$20 Million for Real Estate Fund Fraud
subtitle: Former Banker Convicted Over Fraudulent Brazil Realty Fund Operation
excerpt: Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) has fined former banker Daniel Vorcaro R$20 million, deeming the Brazil Realty real estate fund's operation fraudulent.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
By unanimous decision, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) on Tuesday (8) ordered former banker Daniel Vorcaro to pay R$20 million for an operation of the Brazil Realty real estate fund deemed fraudulent.

The CVM's decision reflects its assessment that the operation in question violated conduct rules in the securities market, thus justifying the imposition of the fine on the responsible party.

This case highlights the CVM's role in combating irregular practices involving real estate funds, reinforcing the importance of market participants adhering to regulations.

With information from Agência Brasil.
